name: Multiscale Hard Voxelization
definition: A CUDA operator that voxelizes a LiDAR point cloud into multiple scales simultaneously, outputting voxel features, coordinates, and point counts per voxel for each scale.
summary: Multiscale Hard Voxelization is a GPU-accelerated method that simultaneously converts LiDAR point clouds into multiple spatial resolutions in a single pass, improving efficiency over separate single-scale operators.
